# Ube

> Ube is an AI growth agent for mobile app teams. It sets up the distribution stack — analytics, attribution, dashboards, paid acquisition, creative testing, A/B tests, and monetization loops — and keeps the loop between ad spend and product learning running, asking for approval at expensive or risky points. Ube Maintainer is a secondary product that turns crashes, app reviews, support signals, and dependency releases into verified pull requests.

## Key facts

- **Company**: Ube, Inc., a Delaware C corporation.
- **Status**: Pre-launch. The site is a demand probe and accepts early-access requests at https://ube.dev.
- **Products**: Ube (flagship, growth and distribution) and Ube Maintainer (secondary, automated maintenance).
- **Pricing**: Three tiers, all selling Ube. Solo is $150/app/month or $120/app/month billed yearly, with managed ad spend up to $1k/month. Team is $500/app/month or $400/app/month billed yearly, with managed ad spend up to $15k/month, team seats, several campaign refreshes per week, and a portfolio view across apps. Enterprise is custom. Neither Solo nor Team caps how many apps a customer brings — the managed ad-spend ceiling is what separates them. Ad spend and optional creative-generation fees are paid directly to those platforms. Ube Maintainer is not sold from a pricing tier.
- **Founder support**: For the first cohort only, on every tier, Ube's founders work with the customer directly to identify a go-to-market plan and propose improvements to existing channels. It is a launch offer, not a standing term.
- **Code privacy**: User code runs in ephemeral, per-repo sandboxes that are destroyed after each job. Ube does not train on user code and does not retain it after the run. Self-hosting is offered for enterprise customers with strict privacy requirements.
- **Auto-merge policy**: Ube always opens PRs for review. Auto-merge is opt-in per repository and remains gated behind existing branch protections and required checks.

## Ube

- **What it is**: A mobile app growth and distribution agent for small teams, solo founders, indie studios, and vibecoders.
- **Built for**: Teams that need the growth stack used by larger app studios without spending months wiring tools before learning from users.
- **Workflow**: Instruments analytics, aligns user IDs and event taxonomy, sets up attribution and SKAdNetwork, builds dashboards, runs acquisition campaigns, refreshes creatives, proposes retention tests, and optimizes monetization once retention is sticky.
- **How paid ads are treated**: As a measurement engine first. Campaigns create a steady stream of users so Ube can find working creatives, identify drop-off points, recommend A/B tests, and improve retention and monetization — and only then scale spend.
- **Approval gates**: Account creation, ad spend, campaign launches, monetization changes, and larger budget increases all require customer approval.
- **Integrations mentioned on the site**: Amplitude, Firebase, AppsFlyer, RevenueCat, Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, AdMob, Apple, Google Play, Sentry, Codemagic, Docker, Bun, Dart, npm, GitHub, Codex, Claude Code, Sett, Clarity, and Creatify.

## Ube Maintainer

- **What it is**: An autonomous software maintenance agent for mobile and cross-platform app teams. Secondary to Ube and not sold from a pricing tier — it is available on request.
- **Built for**: React Native, Expo, Flutter, native iOS (Swift / Obj-C), native Android (Kotlin / Java), and Capacitor / Ionic. Other stacks are onboardable on request.
- **Inputs**: Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry, Play Console ANRs, app store reviews, support inboxes, dependency releases, and repository context.
- **Workflow**: Deduplicates issues across binaries, OS versions, and dependency upgrades; reproduces bugs on emulators; patches and verifies against the test suite; opens a pull request with the diff and recorded reproduction; writes back to the original reporter after the fix ships.
- **Outcome claim**: Early teams running Ube reclaim 10-30% of their engineering time previously spent on triage and dependency maintenance.
